1	# tabulate
2	
3	Aligns delimited text from stdin into a plain-text table.
4	
5	```console
6	$ printf 'id,name\n7,Ann\n10,Bob\n' | tabulate --header
7	id  name
8	--  ----
9	7   Ann
10	10  Bob
11	```
12	
13	## Options
14	
15	| Option | Description |
16	| --- | --- |
17	| `-d`, `--delimiter <CHAR>` | Cell delimiter, or `tab` (default `,`) |
18	| `-H`, `--header` | Underline the first row |
19	| `-b`, `--border` | Draw `\|` between the columns |
20	| `-w`, `--max-width <N>` | Cut cells longer than N characters |
21	| `-c`, `--compact` | **Deprecated, will be removed in 1.0.** Print rows without padding |
22	| `-h`, `--help` | Show the usage text |
23	
24	## Development
25	
26	```console
27	cargo test
28	```

# tabulate

Aligns delimited text from stdin into a plain-text table.

```console
$ printf 'id,name\n7,Ann\n10,Bob\n' | tabulate --header
id  name
--  ----
7   Ann
10  Bob
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-d`, `--delimiter <CHAR>` | Cell delimiter, or `tab` (default `,`) |
| `-H`, `--header` | Underline the first row |
| `-b`, `--border` | Draw `\|` between the columns |
| `-w`, `--max-width <N>` | Cut cells longer than N characters |
| `-c`, `--compact` | **Deprecated, will be removed in 1.0.** Print rows without padding |
| `-h`, `--help` | Show the usage text |

## Development

```console
cargo test
```

I've removed `--compact` / `-c`, and `cargo test` passes with no compiler warnings (14 unit tests and 12 integration tests).

- **`src/cli.rs`:** I removed the `compact` field and its default, the parsing arm that printed the deprecation warning, and the help line. `-c` and `--compact` now fail with the usual unknown-option error.
- **`src/render.rs`:** I removed the compact branch, `render_compact` and `trim_cells`. Nothing else used them.
- **Tests:** I deleted the tests that covered compact output. I added `rejects_the_removed_compact_flag` in `src/cli.rs` and `compact_flag_is_no_longer_accepted` in `tests/cli.rs`. Both check that the flags are rejected, so a later change can't quietly bring them back.
- **Docs:** I removed the row from the README options table. I added a "Removed" entry under Unreleased in `CHANGELOG.md`.

I didn't touch the version number or `Cargo.toml`, so bumping to 1.0 is still yours to do.
